An '''unidentified woman''' was the mother to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], whom she gave birth to in [[92 BBY/Legends|92 BBY]]. Like all Cereans, this woman raised Mundi in a secluded lifestyle and gave her son to Jedi Master [[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]] in [[88 BBY/Legends|88 BBY]] when the latter discovered her son to have [[The Force/Legends|Force]] potential. She is the paternal grandmother to Ki-Adi-Mundi's children.

She died in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Battle of Cerea]] with her daughter, granddaughters, husband, grandsons, and many other civilians.
